effort: none: vibe --thinking is sent as written and only the provider judges it, and on budget-token models high, xhigh and max are one 32000-token budget, with no read-only command to tell (mistral-vibe v3.1.5, completion_profile/reasoning.py)
login: Vibe's own login: vibe --setup saves the key in the OS keyring, or in ~/.vibe/.env when no keyring is available, or you set MISTRAL_API_KEY yourself; the driver never reads or passes it
daemon: vibe -p starts its app-server in its own process group under the turn and exits only after it has; stop ends it with the process tree
signed_out: ^Error: Missing MISTRAL_API_KEY environment variable for .+ provider\.?[ \t]*$
